mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward.  Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage.  Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing <magicDamage>@QDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Stunning</status> them briefly. If the anchor hits terrain, Nautilus will drag himself towards it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>If Nautilus's hook hits terrain, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by @TerrainCDR*100@%, and @TerrainMana*100@% of the Mana cost is refunded.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Dragged Away</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been struck by Nautilus' anchor and cannot move.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Dragged Away</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is has been struck by Nautilus' anchor and cannot move.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus fires a shockwave that chases an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>@PrimaryTargetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, <status>Knocking</status> them <status>Up</status> and <status>Stunning</status> them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also <status>Knocked Up</status> and <status>Stunned</status> and take <magicDamage>@SecondaryTargetDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription:
Depth Charge TargetThis unit has been targetted by Nautilus' Depth Charge ability and is being chased by explosions.

Staying away from this unit would probably be a good idea.Source: @SourceName@
<titleLeft>Depth Charge</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been struck by Nautilus and has been knocked into the air and stunned.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Depth Charge</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been struck by Nautilus and has been knocked into the air briefly.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Staggering BlowNautilus' first basic attack against a target deals @f1@ physical damage and roots for @f2@ seconds.

This effect cannot trigger on the same target more than once every @f3@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageTooltip@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Roots</status> them for @RootDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{ Spell_NautilusPassive_Tooltip }}
This effect cannot trigger on the same target more than once every @PerTargetCD@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Grounded</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is immune to Nautilus' Staggering Blow for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Staggering Blow</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has been hit by Nautilus' Staggering Blow and cannot move for a short time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus gains a temporary Shield.  While it persists, his Attacks deal damage over time to his target and surrounding enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus gains a <shield>@ShieldCalc@ Shield</shield> for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. While the <shield>Shield</shield> persists, Nautilus' Attacks deal an additional <magicDamage>@DotDamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> over 2 seconds to his target and all surrounding enemies.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Wrath</titleLeft><mainText>Nautilus is shielded from incoming damage and his attacks apply a damage over time effect to nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Pain of Wrath</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is taking damage over time.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself. Each explosion damages and slows enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Nautilus creates three exploding waves around himself, each dealing <magicDamage>@DamageCalc@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies in the area and <status>Slows</status> them by @SlowPercent*100@% decaying over @SlowDuration@ seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Waves deal @ExtraWavePenalty*100@% less damage after the first.
This Ability deals @MonsterBonusCalc@ bonus damage to jungle monsters the first time it hits.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Splishy Splashy</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Move Speed is reduced but will gradually return to normal.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
